harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate native-machine-tv-recheck on a real straight-line bundle. The agent discharges only checks Core lists as performed, including the leaf, callee-saved-preservation and supported entry-wrapper checks for this source. The register convention is assumed, not validated; OS exit-status observation is a separate unperformed check. There is no ABI, runtime, CRT/loader, universal object-TV, or Evidence-reuse claim; object_translation_correspondence remains unperformed, and a wrong build ID produces no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm, the same atom used by the #1053 real-Core integration test.
Step 1 builds a real native bundle, verifies its pinned exit status and empty stdout/stderr digests, and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the build ID.

Step 2 captures the raw Core descriptor and the agent report. Assert machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv and machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation are discharged iff Core lists each in checks_performed; this leaf-only source has no branches, calls or loops. Core leaves os_exit_status_observation not performed, and the agent report does not discharge it or object_translation_correspondence. The register convention is assumed, not validated; function outcomes and callee-saved preservation are aggregate counts without function names.

Step 3 reruns with a wrong build ID and asserts no machine-TV outcome, no discharged checks, no selected result, the full current Core/object vocabulary in checks_not_performed including the bounded-loop, callee-saved and entry-wrapper names, and normalized exit_code 1.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show native-machine-tv-recheck on a real straight-line bundle. Core lists the supported leaf, callee-saved-preservation and entry-wrapper checks as performed; the agent discharges only checks present in that descriptor. The atom has no branches, calls or loops. Register convention is assumed, not validated; OS exit-status observation is separate; there is no ABI/runtime, CRT/loader, universal object-TV or Evidence-reuse claim, and object_translation_correspondence remains unperformed.
success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1 and the current checks_performed-derived discharge list: artifact_semantics, claim_truth, machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation, machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv, machine_code_leaf_function_tv, object_call_edge_correspondence, object_link_correspondence, object_symbol_correspondence. checks_not_performed includes machine_code_bounded_loop_function_tv and machine_code_callee_saved_preservation_assumed_for_external_callees plus object_translation_correspondence; Core separately reports os_exit_status_observation as not performed. function_outcomes == {'equivalent_within_profile': 2, 'outside_profile': 0}, callee_saved_preservation == {'preserved': 2, 'violated': 0, 'unknown': 0}, no function names, a selected_result and no candidate.

wrong_report.json carries no machine_tv_recheck or discharged_checks, full current checks_not_performed including machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation and machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv, no selected_result, and normalized exit_code 1.

steps.name: Produce a native bundle with pinned outputs
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==7, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); link_build pins program exit status 7 and empty stdout/stderr digests; bundle/ holds the declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the record pins program exit status 7 and both output channels.

steps.name: Recheck leaf and entry-wrapper machine TV
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle recheck-machine-tv --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --json {output_dir}/bundle {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm > {output_dir}/core_descriptor.json && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-machine-tv-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('{output_dir}/core_descriptor.json')); r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); performed=set(c['checks_performed']); discharged=set(r['discharged_checks']); expected=['artifact_semantics','claim_truth','machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation','machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv','machine_code_leaf_function_tv','object_call_edge_correspondence','object_link_correspondence','object_symbol_correspondence']; not_performed=['file_identity','freshness','function_count','function_coverage','hir_llvm_model_correspondence','llvm_ir_object_equivalence','machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv','machine_code_bounded_loop_function_tv','machine_code_callee_saved_preservation_assumed_for_external_callees','machine_code_composite_register_aggregate_tv','machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv','machine_code_direct_call_site_tv','machine_code_f64_scalar_function_tv','machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv','machine_code_tv_mxcsr_control_state','machine_code_tv_nan_payload_bits','machine_code_tv_sysv_memory_class_aggregate_abi','object_data_correspondence','object_symbol_attribute_correspondence','object_translation_correspondence','producer_authenticity','relocation_applied_values','relocation_bounds','relocation_resolved_values','relocation_targets','semantic_correspondence']; assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1' and r['machine_tv_recheck']=='checked', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==expected and r['checks_not_performed']==not_performed, r; assert all((check in performed)==(check in discharged) for check in ('machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv','machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation')), (c,r); assert {'machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv','machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation'} <= performed, c; assert 'os_exit_status_observation' in c['checks_not_performed'] and 'os_exit_status_observation' not in discharged, (c,r); assert 'object_translation_correspondence' not in discharged, r; assert r['machine_tv_schema']=='mumei.machine-code-tv/v1', r; assert r['register_convention_assumed']=='sysv_x86_64_integer_args_rdi_rsi_rdx_rcx_r8_r9_result_rax', r; assert r['function_outcomes']=={'equivalent_within_profile':2,'outside_profile':0}, r; assert r['callee_saved_preservation']=={'preserved':2,'violated':0,'unknown':0}, r; text=json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True); assert all(json.dumps(name) not in text for name in ('__mumei_user_main','main')), text; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None and 'candidate' not in r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; print('leaf, callee-saved and entry-wrapper checks match Core; OS exit-status observation remains separate and unperformed')"
steps.artifact_contract: core_descriptor.json records Core's actual checks_performed and checks_not_performed; report.json discharges the two new machine-TV checks only when Core lists them, keeps OS exit-status observation and object_translation_correspondence unclaimed, reports aggregate function/preservation counts without names, and selects the matching result.
steps.verifier_gate: The agent's leaf, callee-saved and entry-wrapper discharges match the current Core descriptor; OS exit-status observation remains separate, and no ABI/runtime, CRT/loader or universal object-TV claim is made.

steps.name: Wrong build ID claims no machine-TV outcome
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle recheck-machine-tv --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --json {output_dir}/bundle {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm > {output_dir}/wrong_core.log 2>&1; core_rc=$?; {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-machine-tv-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_machine_tv_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_core.log; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $core_rc -ne 0 && test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); expected=['artifact_semantics','claim_truth','file_identity','freshness','function_count','function_coverage','hir_llvm_model_correspondence','llvm_ir_object_equivalence','machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv','machine_code_bounded_loop_function_tv','machine_code_callee_saved_preservation_assumed_for_external_callees','machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation','machine_code_composite_register_aggregate_tv','machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv','machine_code_direct_call_site_tv','machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv','machine_code_f64_scalar_function_tv','machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv','machine_code_leaf_function_tv','machine_code_tv_mxcsr_control_state','machine_code_tv_nan_payload_bits','machine_code_tv_sysv_memory_class_aggregate_abi','object_call_edge_correspondence','object_data_correspondence','object_link_correspondence','object_symbol_attribute_correspondence','object_symbol_correspondence','object_translation_correspondence','producer_authenticity','relocation_applied_values','relocation_bounds','relocation_resolved_values','relocation_targets','semantic_correspondence']; assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-machine-tv-recheck-report/v1'; assert 'machine_tv_recheck' not in r and not r.get('discharged_checks'), r; assert r['expected_build_id']==hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest(), r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==expected, r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None and 'candidate' not in r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code')==1, r['normalized']; print('wrong build ID: Core exited nonzero; no machine-TV outcome or checks discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: Core exits nonzero; wrong_report.json carries no machine-TV outcome or discharges, the full current checks_not_performed vocabulary including callee-saved and entry-wrapper checks, no selected_result, and normalized exit_code 1.
steps.verifier_gate: A mismatched build ID is rejected by Core and produces no claimed machine-TV outcome.
